newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares slip, AMS sags ahead of Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares slip, AMS sags ahead of Q1 results.

text.p: Austria's blue chip ATX index closed a shade softer on Monday in line with international markets and traders expect the bias to be more on the downside.
"There's a whiff of correction in the air," said one.
The ATX lost 3.64 points or 0.3 percent to 1,202.57 with six shares gaining, 14 falling and one unchanged by the close.
Traders said the market was volatile, liquidity was drying up and that trading was limited to a few sought-after stocks.
"We haven't been able to surpass the 1,210/1,215-point level in the past few days," the trader said, adding there was the danger of a retreat down to 1,170/60 points.
The day's leading decliner was microchip maker AMS, down 5.64 percent at 920 ATS, ahead of the release of its first quarter figures, expected on Tuesday.
"There's an aggressive seller out of London," one trader said about AMS' plunge.
The top gainer was highgrade steelmaker Boehler, up 1.13 percent at 892 ATS to close at a new year high. Selective investor demand earlier drove the stock up to 915.
The Vienna bourse index lost 0.74 points, or 0.16 percent, at 453.65.
The May ATX future fell 4.7 points to 1,191.5 on turnover of 424 lots.
